name: Manipal Academy of Higher Education
overview:
ADDITIONAL PROGRAMME REQUIREMENTS


Students must have a minimum 800 on the Tepitech at the moment of the International Jury in order to be eligible for this destination.


Not recommended for female students


MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION (MAHE Fact Sheet.pdf)


In sixty years, Manipal Academy of Higher Education has become one of the most prestigious private universities in India. It also obtained the status of "deemed university" in 1993, which is a status of autonomy granted to the best performing institutions in the country.


About 20,000 students from 50 countries come to study here each year in one of the Academy’s 20 departments and institutes.


In terms of IT, Manipal has two main institutes: the Manipal Institute of Technology (ranked 6th best engineering college in India in 2011) and the Manipal Center for Information Science, which works closely with industrial giants such as Synopsis Inc, Philips, Whizchip, etc.


One of the Manipal Academy of Higher Education's priorities is to provide its students with the best possible infrastructure. Some of them, like the Innovation Center, serve as a true incubation center for industry and research. The campus also has other impressive infrastructures, notably for sports, of which the largest complex has 5 badminton courts, 4 squash courts, 3 tennis courts, one basketball court, a course track and gym equipment, not to mention the swimming pools as well as the surrounding football and cricket grounds.


The current CEO of Microsoft, Satya Nadella, and the former CEO of Nokia, Rajeev Suri, are all alumni of this university.

administrative:
Application Dossier


You will be working directly with the partner university regarding your application.


You will need to follow 2 steps:

  • Step 1 : Apply through "https://oiac.manipal.edu/"
  • Step 2 : Register on "Studying Abroad Made Easy with Study in India Program"


The steps are also explained in the following document : Steps for Incoming International Student_Application_SII_EVISA


STEP 1 : OIAC application https://oiac.manipal.edu/

  • Use the link to apply,
  • Fill your basic details,
  • Choose your study program at MAHE
  • Upload documents : photo, college ID, Passport, Motivation letter, Tepitech (available on intra),
  • Submit


STEP 2 : Register on "Study India"

You will need to apply for a Study in India ID (SII ID) via the official website : Studying Abroad Made Easy with Study in India Program

  • We strongly recommend that you start this process as soon as possible, as it is quite complex and time-consuming.
  • You must register on the SII platform, fill in your personal details, and wait for your SII ID to be issued.
  • Important: You will not receive a confirmation email as mentioned on the website — please check the platform regularly for updates.
  • Once your SII ID is issued, you can apply for your chosen course on the SII portal. Your application will then be forwarded to Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) for review.


Please note that the SII ID will get synced with the E-Visa website and it is not within the control of MAHE. We wish to mention that the turnaround time for this synchronization is currently quite uncertain


Receipt of the Letter of Acceptance from MIT


  • After MAHE approves your request and uploads your invitation letter, you will receive the letter and an option to accept the offer
  • Download the invitation letter and accept the offer and allow a few days before proceeding to the next step


Visa Application and residence permit


Once your Study in India ID process is complete, you can apply for the e-Student Visa online at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/evisa/tvoa.html. Be sure to use the official government (.gov.in) website.


All the steps for the visa application are also explained in this document : Study in India (SII ID) and E-Student Visa Application Process


The visa application requires you to fill out a detailed questionnaire and upload the following documents:

  • Passport (valid for at least 6 months)
  • Passport-size photographs
  • Photocopy of your passport
  • Proof of residential address
  • Printed copy of the completed online form
  • Formal admission letter (provided by the DPR or AFFI team)
  • TEPitech
  • University details
  • Recent bank statement


Once your visa is approved, you can be processed through the e-Visa counters upon arrival in India, where your biometrics will be taken. Please ensure that you read the information on both websites carefully and complete your applications accurately. Once you submit your visa application, the fee must be paid and will not be refunded, even if your application is rejected. The visa application process is individual and must be completed by each student personally.


Please feel free to check the brochure (Incoming Student Brochure)


Kindly apply for your Accomodation & Transport immediatly on receipt of your visa via https://oiac.manipal.edu/


Students are strongly adviced to stay on campus, but if you wish to stay off-campus, please ensure the property have duly registered Form C with e-FRRO.


1) If you are staying in campus hostel


The Chief Warden at the University will facilitate Form C online on the day of arrival. Report to the Chief Warden's office (room #105, Level 1, Edu building, MAHE). Soft copy of the complemented Form C will be emailed to the student.


2) If you are staying outside the campusGet the Form C done from the landlord of the apartment/hostel on the day of arrival


Please read here e-FRRO Home


How to use e-FFRO :

  • Visit the e-FFRO portal
  • Submit your application with the mentioned supporting documents (photograph, passport, visa, bonafide certificate (or proof of study), eligibility letter, Form C)
  • Keep a tab on your email for updates
  • Applicants shall receive his/her 'Residence Permit' (RC/RP) within 10-12 days of submission
  • If no update, please sign in to the e-FFRO portal and check the status
  • On successfull submission of the application, RC/RP will be sent to the registered email ID of the applicant
  • A copy of the RC/RP should be submitted to the college office for records
  • Applicant must ensure to leave the country on/before the expiry of the RC/RP depsite of the visa validity period
  • Applicants should carry the RC/RP along with the passport for verification at the airport immigration desk


Upon your arrival:


If you Visa duration exceeds 180 days, students must then, within 14 days of your arrival in India, register with the Foreigners Registration Office (FRO) at the city police station. You will have to complete the e-FRRO registration and the College office will issue you a Bonafide certificate.

Students are advisable to report first to the Office of International Affairs & collaborations (OIAC), 3rd floor, Edu building, Manipal, with their passports for visa verification and to confirm their e-FRRO registration status.


Health and Insurance


It is imperative that you take out insurance that will cover you for your medical and hospital expenses, repatriation and accompanied by civil liability. International insurance must cover the entire period of your studies in the country. Insurance costs are the responsibility of each student.

To take out international insurance, the market is quite open. Please click here for more information.


For more information, you can consult the country's health file at: https://www.pasteur.fr/fr/centre-medical/preparer-son-voyage/inde

Note: It is advisable to register on the French register established outside France and to report to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs via the Ariane platform: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html

courses:
Credits


You must take a total number of 40 local credits over the year.

  • 1st part: Validate modules during the 1st semester (20 local credits)
  • 2nd part: Validate a project during the 2nd semester (20 local credits)


Academic Calendar


The semester dates are as follows:

  • S1: Mid-July to late November
  • S2: Early January to late May


Department and Courses


You will take courses in English in the MAE MIT Program.


1. First Part – Modules (20 local credits)

You will have to choose courses from the following programs:


Master of Computer Application (MCA) – Lateral Entry 3rd Semester


Code - Course Title - Credits


MAT 535 - Computational Mathematics - 4

MCA 583 - Object Oriented Programming & Design - 4

MCA 585 - Advanced Data Structure & Algorithms - 4

MCA 587 - Software Engineering and Project Management - 4

MCA 589 - Advanced Database Management System - 4

MCA 591 - Data Structure & Algorithms Lab- 2

MCA 593 - Object Oriented Programming Lab - 1

MCA 595 - Advanced DBMS Lab - 1


Master of Technology in Computer Science and Information Security (CSIS) – First Year, First Semester


Code - Course Title - Credits


MAT 511 - Computational Methods and Stochastic Processes - 4

CSE 521 - Distributed Computing Systems - 4

CSE 523 - Number Theory & Cryptography - 4

CSE 503 - Advanced Computer Networks - 4

CSE 525 - Security Architecture - Design and Analysis - 4

HSS 501 - Research Methodologies and Technical Communication - 2

CSE 531 - Information Systems Lab 1 - 2


Other Available Courses:

  • DWDM (Data Warehouse Data Mining): 4 credits
  • AI (Artificial Intelligence): 3 credits


Each course is equivalent to four hours per week and earns 4 credits (except AI, which lasts only 3 hours and therefore earns 3 credits).

You will sometimes have lessons on Saturday afternoon, but one free day during the week.


2. Second Part – Project


Project to be carried out in a group and under the tutelage of the university.


Course format and workload

  • Attendance is compulsory, under penalty of exclusion from the university.
  • A minimum of 75% attendance per subject is required to be eligible to participate in partials at the end of the semester.


Important notes

  • Presence in class is compulsory, under penalty of loss of visa and repatriation to France at the student's expense (impact on credits).
  • The courses are most likely more academic than at EPITECH.
  • The course list is given for information only. It can change from year to year.
  • If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
  • Any Tech 4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance it.
cost:
Financial overview (4th yeat at Epitech)


  • You must pay the tuition fees for the 4th year of EPITECH, as well as the re-registration fees and related fees.
  • EPITECH covers the tuition fees at the partner university.
  • Other costs at your expense include: travel, accommodation on site, insurance, and everyday expenses (books, food, transport, etc.).


Other expenses


  • Roundtrip airfare: From 750 €
  • Several flight options are possible:
  • You can land in Mangalore and take a taxi to Manipal (70 km) or arrive in Mumbai and take a plane to Mangalore.
  • Visa: Less than 100 €
  • Medical costs: 43 € (payable to the university)
  • Insurance: 300-600€ depending on the coverage


Estimated monthly budget


The local currency is the Indian rupee. 1 € = 101 INR (rate in October 2025)


Please check the Numbeo website to compare the cost of living between your city of origin and your city of exchange. Please note that everyone's budget will be different according to one's lifestyle.


Housing : 200-300€, Or 11€/night on campus


Food & eating out : 60 - 100€

  • 8,40€/day (breakfast and meals) at campus food court


Transport : 15-35€

  • A bus trip to a destination costs 10 to 20 rupees (0.2 €). A rickshaw ride costs 30 to 250 rupees, depending on the distance. Always ask the driver to put the meter!


Phone & Internet : 8-10€


Leisure : 15-50€

  • 1,750 rupees/month (21 €) (“Marena” room next to the campus);
  • A train ticket costs 400 rupees (4.8 €) for "sleeper" class (with bunks, no A/C). 500 rupees (6 €) with A/C to go to Pondicherry (18 hours);
  • A "high-end" cinema seat (in well-placed armchairs) costs 300 rupees (€ 3.6)


These prices are indicative and may vary.


Specifics and advice


  • The electricity can cut off from time to time in certain areas of the city (it's like that everywhere in India).
  • It is important to never trust an intermediary who manages the rental of a house for an owner.
  • The monsoon, when the students arrive, will last until the beginning of September. So remember to bring a good umbrella.
  • You will initially have a little trouble understanding the English accent of the Indians, but you will get used to it very quickly.
